```{r Loading packages, echo=TRUE}
library(readxl)
```

```{r Setup working directory, echo=TRUE}
setwd("/Users/markruperto/Desktop/School/GCU/BIT-446/Topic 5 - Model Evalutaion")
```

```{r Importing FailureRate1, echo=TRUE}
FailureRate <- read_excel("FailureRate1.xlsx")
FailureRate <- FailureRate[1:300, ]
head(FailureRate)
```
```{r Model features, echo=TRUE}
#Select features
features <- FailureRate[, c("hours_run", "avg_hours_between_maint")]

#Normalize
features_scaled <- scale(features)

#Convert to dataframe
features_scaled <- as.data.frame(features_scaled)

head(features_scaled)
```

```{r Creating training and test partitions, echo=TRUE}
library(caTools)

set.seed(44)

sample <- sample.split(FailureRate$failure, SplitRatio = 0.7)

train_failure <- subset(FailureRate, sample == TRUE)
test_failure  <- subset(FailureRate, sample == FALSE)

train_failure$failure <- as.factor(train_failure$failure)
test_failure$failure  <- as.factor(test_failure$failure)

nrow(train_failure)
nrow(test_failure)
```
```{r KNN Model, echo=TRUE}
library(class)

#Using normalized features for KNN
train_x <- features_scaled[sample == TRUE, ]
test_x  <- features_scaled[sample == FALSE, ]

#Target variable
train_y <- train_failure$failure

#Run KNN (k = 5)
failureKNN <- knn(train = train_x, test = test_x, cl = train_y, k = 5)

#View predictions
head(failureKNN)
```

```{r Bind Predictions, echo=TRUE}

#Bind failureKNN to test_failure
test_ObsPred <- data.frame(test_failure, failureKNN)

head(test_ObsPred)
```

```{r Model Results, echo=TRUE}
library(ggplot2)
library(lattice)
library(caret)

#Confusion matrix and model performance
confusionMatrix(data = test_ObsPred$failureKNN,
                reference = test_ObsPred$failure,
                mode = "prec_recall")
```

```{r Comprehensive Metrics Summary, echo=TRUE}
library(metrica)

obs <- as.numeric(paste(test_failure$failure))
pred <- as.numeric(paste(test_ObsPred$failureKNN))

metrics_data <- data.frame(obs = obs, pred = pred)

metrics_summary(
  data = metrics_data,
  obs = obs,
  pred = pred,
  type = "classification",
  pos_level = 1
)
```

Overall, the KNN model performed very well in predicting failure. The accuracy is high at 93.33%, which means most predictions were correct. The model also has strong precision and recall, showing that it does a good job identifying actual failures and doesn’t miss many of them. The F1 score supports this by showing a good balance between these two measures.

One weakness is the lower specificity, which means the model sometimes incorrectly predicts failure when there isn’t one (false positives). However, the balanced accuracy and kappa value still show the model is reliable overall.

Based on these results and the confusion matrix, this model would be useful for predicting failure, especially when it is important not to miss true failure cases.
